subject: Clearinghouse handoff: SOW milestones, kickoff cadence & initial runbook
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Lena Torres <lena@clearinghousehealth.com>, Samir Desai <samir@clearinghousehealth.com>, procurement@clearinghousehealth.com
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Clearinghouse handoff: SOW milestones, kickoff cadence & initial runbook

Team — handing over Clearinghouse Health (Enterprise, committed $1.2M ARR). Short summary for CS intake and first-week plan. Please read and confirm owner by EOD.

Deal context
- Product: Hosted inference (text generation + embeddings) + Dedicated pool for high-volume batch scoring.
- Closing items: SOW signed (attached as Clearinghouse_SOW_v3.pdf), PO pending (procurement looped).
- SLA expectations: 99.95% with 95ms p50 token latency target on their dedicated pool (listed in SOW).

Key milestones (mutual action plan attached)
1) Contract signed & PO received — target: 2026-09-03 (Procurement)
2) Kickoff + tech discovery — target: 2026-09-07 (CS + Eng)
3) Staging access & model onboarding — 2 weeks post-kickoff
4) Cutover to dedicated pool + acceptance testing — 4–6 weeks post-kickoff

Technical notes (from discovery)
- Primary integration: HTTPS API; they will require SAML SSO for enterprise users and VPC egress allowlisting.
- Data residency: US-only (N. Virginia).
- Expected load pattern: steady baseline of 25 RPS with spikes to 120 RPS for nightly scoring windows.
- Their current models: two custom Llama variants (7B/13B) — we will serve quantized variants on Dedicated.

Risks / open asks
- Procurement contact has not returned the PO; Ben is managing discounts/credits — see deal notes in HubSpot.
- They requested SOC2 evidence and pen-test summary (Lena will send formal list).
- Need to confirm whether they want feature-flagged rollback windows for the cutover (recommended).

Required immediate actions from CS team
- Assign primary CS owner and secondary (shadow)
- Confirm kickoff attendees and propose 60-minute agenda (tech discovery + acceptance criteria)
- Prep a runbook outline for staging onboarding (templates in Drive link)

Attachments: Clearinghouse_SOW_v3.pdf, mutual_action_plan.csv, tech-questions-clearinghouse.xlsx

Next step: Please ack and nominate owner. I recommend Tessa as primary given her Dedicated experience; Monica to lead acceptance criteria & training.

Thanks — Karthik
--
Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192
From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Lena Torres <lena@clearinghousehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Clearinghouse handoff: SOW milestones, kickoff cadence & initial runbook

Thanks Karthik — acknowledged. I can take ownership of acceptance criteria and onboarding training.
A few clarifying Qs from my side:
- Do they require a dedicated VPC peering or just IP allowlisting for staging? (Karthik / Lena?)
- Will they expect dedicated capacity from day 1 for the nightly scoring? If yes, we'll need to reserve burst capacity in advance.
- For SOC2 evidence: can we provide the standard security packet + our pen test summary? (Ben / Security)

Action: I'll draft the kickoff agenda and send a proposed attendee list by EOD. Tessa — can you confirm when you can run a 90-minute tech deep-dive the week of 9/7?

Monica
--
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
monica@redwood.ai
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Lena Torres <lena@clearinghousehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Clearinghouse handoff: SOW milestones, kickoff cadence & initial runbook

Putting myself up as primary, happy to lead the implementation and run the tech deep-dive. Available slots: 9/7 10–12 PT or 9/8 13–15 PT.

Notes for runbook: I'll use the Dedicated onboarding checklist (Drive link) and will add a section for quantized model validation and KV cache sizing for their nightly workload.

Ben — can you confirm whether procurement is holding for final signature vs PO, and if any finance hold will delay kickoff? I want to flag scheduling decisions if we need to wait on a PO to provision Dedicated.

Tessa
--
Tessa Morgan
Implementation Lead, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@clearinghousehealth.com, Lena Torres <lena@clearinghousehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2026 12:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Clearinghouse handoff: SOW milestones, kickoff cadence & initial runbook

Confirming procurement is engaged — procurement@clearinghousehealth.com has the final SOW and asked for our standard PO template. I shared the DocuSign link; they said they'd expedite and target 9/3. No finance holds on our side.

Assigning roles: Tessa (Primary implementation owner), Monica (Acceptance & Customer enablement), Ben (Exec sponsor for escalations). I also added our infra contact (cc'd) for allowlist/VPC questions.

I'll post the short execution playbook to the Drive folder and share the link here once uploaded.

-Ben
From: Lena Torres <lena@clearinghousehealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Desai <samir@clearinghousehealth.com>, procurement@clearinghousehealth.com
Date: Tue, 31 Aug 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Clearinghouse handoff: SOW milestones, kickoff cadence & initial runbook

Thanks everyone — appreciate the concise plan. A couple of asks from our side before kickoff:
1) Confirmed kickoff: 9/7 10:30–11:30 PT (we'll do a calendar invite).
2) SOC2 + pen-test summary — Samir will drop our checklist to procurement; can you provide the security packet by 9/2?
3) SAML: We will need an SP metadata file and a timeline for SSO validation. Can you confirm whether Redwood can support SAML in staging before production cutover?

We'll loop in our network engineer (cc'd) if you need IPs for allowlisting. Looking forward to the kickoff.

Best — Lena
Clearinghouse Health
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>

Perfect — confirmed for 9/7 10:30–11:30 PT.
Action items I will close this week:
- Share DocuSign SOW link and track PO (DocuSign envelope: https://docusign.com/envelope/AA123456789).
- Security packet (SOC2 + pen-test summary) — Ben, can we have this to them by 9/2?

I'll keep the customer looped and will update the HubSpot deal once PO lands. Thanks team — nice handoff.

-Karthik
